items.title: HAL Q1 Results: Net profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 1,590 crore, revenue up 14%
items.description: Hindustan Aeronautics reported an impressive fifteen percent increase in net profit for the first quarter, showcasing robust financial health. Alongside, the company observed a fourteen percent year-on-year rise in operational revenue for the April-June period of the fiscal year twenty twenty-seven. Released on a Wednesday, the findings revealed that HAL shares experienced slight gains following this promising report.

items.title: Tata Motors CV Q1 Results: Net profit soars 83% YoY to Rs 2,560 cr on one-time gain from Tata Capital; revenue jumps 19%
items.description: Tata Motors CV Q1 Results: Commercial vehicle major Tata Motors on Wednesday reported a net profit of Rs 2,560 in the first quarter of financial year 2027, marking a jump of 83.3% from Rs 1,397 crore reported in the same period last year.

items.title: Lenskart Q1 Results: Profit zooms 182% YoY to Rs 228 crore; revenue up 34%
items.description: Lenskart Solutions reported a 182.3% YoY jump in Q1 FY27 profit to Rs 228 crore, while revenue rose 33.6% to Rs 2,214 crore. EBITDA increased 61.3% to Rs 589 crore, with margins expanding and product margin crossing 70% for the first time.

items.title: Grasim Industries swings to profit in Q1, revenue rises 21% YoY
items.description: Grasim Industries reported strong Q1 FY27 results, with standalone net profit reaching Rs 247 crore and revenue rising 28% YoY. Consolidated net profit jumped 51% to Rs 2,146 crore, driven by robust performance across core and growth businesses.

items.title: Gokaldas Exports Q1 profit jumps 7% as US tariff pressure eases
items.description: Gokaldas Exports reported a 7% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹44 crore, while income climbed 21% to ₹1,180 crore. Recovery followed tariff disruptions, supported by stronger India order execution, Africa volumes and productivity initiatives.

items.title: IndiQube Spaces Q1 revenue jumps 37% to record Rs 428 crore
items.description: IndiQube Spaces reported record Q1FY27 revenue of ₹428 crore, up 37% year-on-year. EBITDA rose 34%, while PAT surged 91% to ₹35 crore. Area under management and seat capacity expanded, alongside stronger occupancy and rapidly growing value-added services.
